tool_args.rationale: All five pilot horizons are at or below 0.48, while the forecast target is H=19.9. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the initial positive gain persists or reverses as the slow component develops.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: For short horizons, the slow term depends mainly on the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. A good pilot fit would not establish the sign or magnitude at H=19.9.
It can account for the positive short-window response but cannot reverse sign. The pilot does not distinguish it from delayed adaptation.
The key uncertainty is the response at long horizons, not the resolution of the early transient.
